core_obligations: Set up the comparison: restrict to the torsion ring case, invoke the cofiltered category of compactifications from the Nagata theorem and the two More on Flatness lemmas, and recall the K-injective construction of the functor attached to a compactification (proof lines 3306-3328).

Build the isomorphisms: for a morphism g between compactifications, produce the isomorphism of functors through the chain R overline-f_{2,*} j_{2,!} = R overline-f_{2,*} Rg_* j_{1,!} = R overline-f_{1,*} j_{1,!} using lemma-shriek-lqf-and-proper in the first equality (proof lines 3331-3339).

Reduce to compositions: use cofilteredness with the footnote cancellation argument (gamma composite alpha equals gamma composite beta implies alpha equals beta) to reduce well-definedness to compositions of morphisms of compactifications being sent to compositions of the constructed isomorphisms (proof lines 3342-3348).

Verify the composition compatibility: for a third compactification and h, unfold the long chain, reduce by the calculation to the agreement of the j_! structure maps with the composite map, and conclude from lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose via the special-case identification with lemma-shriek-proper-and-open (proof lines 3349-3372).
proof_roadmap: Cofiltered category of compactifications and K-injective construction (proof lines 3306-3328).
Isomorphisms attached to morphisms of compactifications (proof lines 3331-3339).
Cofiltered cancellation reduces to composition compatibility, concluded by the compose lemma (proof lines 3342-3372).
